jobs.title: Medior/Senior Software Engineer 🚀 regio Utrecht - Uitzendbureau.nl
jobs.description:
Wat ga je doen:

Hier krijg je als engineer écht de ruimte om het verschil te maken bij grote organisaties. Geen eindeloze rapporten, maar direct bouwen, verantwoordelijkheid nemen en samen met een scherp team impact maken.

Je werkt aan het ontwerpen en bouwen van maatwerkapplicaties, slimme AI-tools en integraties met het Power Platform. Jij zorgt dat de wensen van de klant vertaald worden naar heldere technische oplossingen. Je begint met het scherp krijgen van de klantvraag, bedenkt samen met je team de beste technische aanpak en bouwt die uit tot werkende software. Je ontwikkelt cloud-native applicaties, legt integraties tussen systemen en houdt je bezig met het opzetten van een veilige, onderhoudbare architectuur.

Op een gemiddelde dag ben je bezig met het uitdenken en ontwikkelen van nieuwe features, het reviewen van code van collega’s en het begeleiden van minder ervaren engineers. Je overlegt direct met de klant over wensen en eisen, maakt inschattingen voor nieuwe projecten en zorgt dat de software netjes wordt uitgerold via CI/CD. Je werkt met C#, Azure, Power Platform en AI en tilt samen de technische standaard omhoog.

Hier krijg je de vrijheid om zelf keuzes te maken, verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en direct invloed te hebben op het eindresultaat. Is deze rol iets voor jou? Solliciteer direct of kom langs voor een kop koffie.

Wat wij bieden:

Salaris tussen €4500 en €6250 per maand
Leaseauto of mobiliteitsbudget
Hybride werken: thuis, op kantoor of bij de klant
Opleidingsbudget om je verder te ontwikkelen
Maandelijkse teamuitjes en sportbudget
Grote projecten bij bekende klanten

Over het bedrijf:

Je werkt bij een IT-bureau in de regio Utrecht waar weinig managementlagen zijn en veel ruimte is voor initiatief. De sfeer is informeel, direct en iedereen denkt mee over het eindresultaat. Samen met andere engineers werk je aan softwareprojecten, AI- en Power Platform-oplossingen voor grote organisaties. Er is veel kennisdeling en ruimte om te groeien. Je merkt meteen dat het team energiek en open is en dat iedereen gericht is op het maken van oplossingen die werken.

Vereisten:

Minimaal 4 jaar ervaring als software engineer (medior of senior)
Kennis van C#, Power Platform, Azure en AI
Ervaring met softwareontwikkeling van idee tot implementatie
Mentaliteit: bouwen, aanpakken, verantwoordelijkheid nemen
Je durft je eigen technische keuzes te maken en initiatief te tonen

jobs.title: Software Engineering Intern – Device Simulation & Digital Twin
jobs.description:
Company Description

At KEENFINITY Group
, we are a globally leading provider of innovative and professional security and communication solutions. With over 4,000 employees in over 50 countries worldwide, our ambition is clear: we offer more than just technology – we secure, connect, and amplify the moments that matter in life.

Our Audio business is part of the Keenfinity Group and operates as an independent company – giving our iconic brands the independence and agility to thrive in today’s market. As part of a global family that includes Bosch, RTS, Electro-Voice, Dynacord, and Telex
, we deliver world-class professional audio, building safety, intercom, and communication solutions that connect concerts, broadcasts, houses of worship, stadiums, and schools. We develop and manufacture these systems in our own plants across Europe, the Americas, and Asia.

Our vision is to be the industry’s most admired company, driven by customer success. We strive to live and work according to our core values of Customer Success, Passion, Boldness, and Integrity.

Customer Success: Unmatched customer experience, end to end.

Passion: We love what we do, it drives everything we deliver.

Boldness: We challenge the status quo. We innovate. We lead.

Integrity: We do the right thing. Always.

What’s in it for you?

Working with us means experiencing the best of both worlds: the global impact and prestige of industry-leading brands, combined with the agility and entrepreneurial energy of a newly independent company. In this dynamic environment, your ideas will not get lost in bureaucracy. We empower you to take true ownership, accelerate your growth, and collaborate with passionate experts worldwide to build solutions you can genuinely be proud of.

Job Description

As a Software Engineering Intern – Device Simulation & Digital Twin
, you will help us rebuild and significantly expand the software simulator for our DICENTIS conference devices
. The simulator acts like real hardware on the network, allowing our development and test teams to validate server behavior, run automated regression tests, and develop software without always needing access to physical devices.

We already have an existing simulator, but it currently covers only a limited set of device behaviors and runs on an aging technology stack. Your project will be to rebuild it using a newer technology foundation that we are already investing in, while expanding its coverage from approximately 30% to 80–90% of real device behavior
.

You will work on a long-term project with a tangible impact on how our engineering teams develop, test, and maintain our products. The final solution will run on both Windows and Linux
and become an important part of our automated testing and development environment.

During Your Internship, You Will

Get familiar with the existing device simulator, DICENTIS devices, and the newer technology stack used for the rebuild.
Analyze the behavior and capabilities of real devices and identify which scenarios are already simulated and which are still missing.
Define and prioritize the device behaviors required to significantly expand simulator coverage.
Design and implement new simulated device scenarios using C# and/or C++.
Develop software that communicates over the network and behaves like the corresponding physical devices.
Make the simulator compatible with both Windows and Linux.
Develop and maintain automated tests that use the simulator as a replacement for physical hardware.
Integrate the simulator into our automated build and test pipeline, including continuous integration where applicable.
Document supported device behaviors, architecture, usage, and known limitations.
Work closely with engineers and testers to understand their needs and ensure the simulator is practical for everyday development and testing.
Break down a long-term project into manageable milestones and provide regular progress updates to your supervising team.

Qualifications

You are currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, or a related technical field.
Solid programming skills in C# and/or C++.
Good understanding of object-oriented programming and software design principles.
Basic understanding of networking concepts such as TCP/IP, client-server communication, and networked devices.
Ability to work independently, take ownership of tasks, and break down a larger project into manageable steps.
Good written and spoken English communication skills.
Motivation to learn, investigate technical problems, and develop a solution from an existing foundation.

It Is a Plus If You Have

Experience with .NET or .NET Core.
Familiarity with network protocols or device communication standards.
Experience with automated testing or continuous integration tools such as Jenkins.
Experience working in a Linux-based development environment.
Coursework or project experience in software engineering, networking, embedded systems, or distributed systems.
An interest in audio, conferencing technology, embedded systems, or connected devices.

Additional Information

💼 What We Offer:

A hands-on internship in an international team.
Close guidance from experienced professionals.
A dynamic role where your input and ideas are appreciated.
The option to work from home one day per week.
An internship allowance between €500 and €600 per month (based on full-time employment).

📝 Application Process

Interested? Hit the apply button!
Phone meeting with a Keenfinity Group campus recruiter;
Interview with team members;
Contract offers from Keenfinity Group.

🌱 Join us at KEENFINITY!

At Keenfinity Group we don’t just build innovative solutions — we shape a smarter, more connected world through technology.

We value different backgrounds, ideas, and experiences and we’re committed to growing, learning, and celebrating success as one team. Everyone is welcome here — we foster an environment where everyone is respected, valued, and encouraged to be their authentic self.

Keenfinity is an equal opportunity employer, offering equal opportunities for all. We welcome applications from people with disabilities and can offer support, if needed. When everyone has a chance to contribute, we all do better.

jobs.title: Cloud Engineer
jobs.description:
We are supporting a host of organisation within the life sciences sector as they continue to invest in their technology and cloud environment.

We are looking for an experienced Cloud Engineers to support the design, implementation and ongoing improvement of scalable, secure cloud infrastructure across a complex enterprise environment.

You will work closely with infrastructure, architecture, security and application teams to help deliver cloud solutions that support wider digital and technology transformation programmes.

Key responsibilities will include:
Designing, building and maintaining cloud infrastructure across AWS and/or Azure
Supporting cloud migration and modernisation initiatives
Building and maintaining infrastructure using Terraform / Infrastructure as Code
Developing and improving CI/CD pipelines and automation
Working with Kubernetes, containers and modern cloud-native technologies
Supporting cloud security, governance and compliance requirements
Monitoring, troubleshooting and improving cloud platform performance
Working with internal technology teams and external partners across Europe

What we're looking for
Strong commercial experience working as a Cloud Engineer / Cloud Infrastructure Engineer / DevOps Engineer
Strong experience with AWS and/or Microsoft Azure
Infrastructure-as-Code experience, ideally Terraform
Experience with Kubernetes, Docker and CI/CD tooling
Strong automation and scripting capability
Previous experience working within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical devices or wider life sciences environments would be highly advantageous
Experience operating within regulated or highly controlled environments
Comfortable working within international technology teams

This is an excellent opportunity to join a significant technology programme within an organisation continuing to invest heavily across cloud, infrastructure and digital transformation.

If you are currently contracting within the life sciences market, or have previously delivered cloud programmes across pharmaceutical or biotechnology organisations, I'd be keen to hear from you.

jobs.description:
In Deiner Mission Blühst Du Auf, Denn

Du entwickelst und betreibst moderne Cloud- & AI-Anwendungen auf Basis von Microsoft Azure Foundry und treibst deren kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung voran.
Dabei konzipierst und implementierst du skalierbare Frontend- und Backend-Lösungen mit Technologien wie Vue.js, Nuxt, Node.js und Python.
Du automatisierst Infrastruktur- und Deployment-Prozesse mithilfe von Infrastructure as Code und CI/CD-Pipelines und sorgst für einen stabilen und effizienten Projekterfolg, als Basis für den späteren Betrieb der Lösung.
Gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen analysierst du Anforderungen, entwickelst passgenaue Lösungen und begleitest deren Umsetzung bis zum produktiven Einsatz.
Darüber hinaus übernimmst du Verantwortung für Monitoring, Security und Performance der Anwendungen und bringst eigene Ideen zur Optimierung von Architektur und Entwicklungsprozessen ein.

Deine Skills? Mehr als interessant:

Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im IT-Umfeld, ein Studium der Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit entsprechender Praxiserfahrung.
Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Entwicklung moderner Webanwendungen mit JavaScript, TypeScript, Vue.js/Nuxt und Node.js sowie im Design und der Anbindung von REST-APIs.
Gute Kenntnisse der Microsoft-Azure-Plattform, insbesondere Azure App Services, Azure Functions, Container Services und grundlegender Cloud-Infrastruktur.
Erfahrung mit Infrastructure as Code, vorzugsweise Terraform, sowie mit Azure DevOps, CI/CD-Pipelines, Git und modernen Deployment-Prozessen.
Persönlich überzeugen uns deine analytische und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise, deine Kommunikationsstärke sowie dein Interesse, Entwicklungs-, Cloud- und DevOps-Themen ganzheitlich zu betrachten.

Du Verdienst Echten Mehrwert. Freu Dich Deshalb Auf

Weiterentwicklung: Mit einem umfangreichen Angebot der Bechtle Akademie, individueller Karriereplanung, Expert:innen- und Führungsprogrammen, Herstellerzertifizierungen und vielem mehr entwickelst du dich kontinuierlich weiter und bleibst niemals stehen.
Rund-um-Sorglos-Paket: Deine Zukunft ist uns wichtig. Das zeigt unsere attraktive Berufsunfähigkeitsversicherung sowie unsere betriebliche Altersversorgung mit einer Bezuschussung von bis zu 100 Prozent.
30 Tage Urlaub: 6 Wochen freie Zeit, die du zur Erholung, Entspannung, zum Reisen und Füße hochlegen nutzen kannst.
Modern Workplace: Am Arbeitsplatz der Zukunft erhältst du neuestes Technikequipment und arbeitest in einem innovativen Arbeitsumfeld.
Abwechslung: In deinen eigenverantwortlich geführten Projekten kannst du unsere vielfältigen Kunden kennenlernen und erhältst Einblick in die unterschiedlichsten Branchen.
Veranstaltungen: Erfolge werden bei uns gefeiert, zum Beispiel bei unseren Mitarbeitendenevents, Weihnachtsfeiern sowie Sommer- und Grillfesten.

Das erwartet dich im Bechtle IT-Systemhaus Stuttgart/Rottenburg: Wir sind eine Gesellschaft mit zwei Standorten – Stuttgart-Möhringen, eingebettet in den innovativen Zukunfts-Hub am Campus Sternhöhe, und Rottenburg. Wir bündeln unsere Kompetenzen für die digitale Zukunft und arbeiten gemeinsam mit rund 400 Kolleg:innen an Themen wie IT Security & Networking, Microsoft Hybrid & Cloud Solutions, Modern Workplace, SmartCity und mehr. Dich erwarten agile Teams, moderne Technologien und echte Entwicklungsperspektiven.
